create_model: create a new model entry in the open-webui models database with name, params, and access control settings
search_models: search open-webui models by query string with pagination, ordering, and access control filtering
update_model: update an existing open-webui model by id with new name, params, meta, or access control values
toggle_model: toggle the is_active status of an open-webui model by its id to enable or disable it
delete_model: delete an open-webui model entry from the database by its id
